correctness.rationale: The width function has exactly three constant pieces for a two-level channel. Integrating \(-w\log_2 w\) over the nontrivial interval gives the divergence contribution \((a_y-b_y)(-m_y\log_2m_y)/P_Y(y)\); weighting by \(P_Y(y)\) and summing proves the formula. The q-ary symmetric branches follow by identifying the high-likelihood set. In the conventional regime, entropy concavity proves the exact maximum gap and its equality conditions. Boundary cases are stated explicitly.

value.rationale: Functional information is a one-shot lower-bound quantity for exact channel simulation. The result gives a complete source-prior-dependent expression for a canonical family across all crossover levels and an exact worst-case improvement over mutual information in the conventional regime. It identifies the uniform source as the extremizer and exposes the high-noise branch where the entropy dependence changes. This is a focused operational formula, not a claim of a new coding algorithm.
